Subject: Proposed 75-min ML/infra deep-dive for AsterBio — slots & attendee roster

Hi Kelly —

Great to meet earlier — quick recap and concrete next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive. Thanks for walking us through AsterBio's immediate priorities: low-latency inference for batch experiments, 99th-pctl latency targets for serving (<120ms), and the need to keep PII within the US region. You mentioned a 6–8 week pilot and wanting an initial cost band to present to procurement.

Proposed next step: 75-minute technical deep-dive with our ML infra and serving team (will include runbook, example workloads, and a short evaluation plan). Please confirm which of these slots works for you and who from your team will attend:

- Tue, Apr 3 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Wed, Apr 4 — 2:00–3:15 PM PT
- Thu, Apr 5 — 11:30 AM–12:45 PM PT

Proposed agenda (attached PDF):
1) 10 min — goals & success criteria (you)
2) 20 min — architecture & data controls (our infra lead)
3) 20 min — live walk-through: model serving + KV/cache behavior with your workload patterns
4) 15 min — evaluation plan & cost/throughput projections
5) 10 min — open Q&A & next steps / mutual action items

Attachments: redwood-tdx-agenda-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan-AsterBio.xlsx (MVP checklist + kickoff owners).

If you can confirm a slot, please also confirm attendees (we recommend including your infra lead + data security contact). We’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read with test prompts and environment details.

Thanks — I’ll hold the three slots for now.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
